title: arum italicum subsp. canariense
intro: Arum italicum subsp. canariense, commonly known as Canary Arum or Italian Arum, is a subspecies of flowering plant that belongs to the Arum genus and is native to the Canary Islands. It is used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and acting as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Arum italicum subsp. canariense include stimulating digestion, reducing spasms, and acting as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
